Block ads at the DNS level
AetherDNS configures Android\'s built-in Private DNS (DNS-over-TLS) to use a resolver that filters ads and trackers.
Android itself runs the encrypted DNS. Once set up, AetherDNS can be closed and protection stays on.
AetherDNS does not use the VPN slot, so WireGuard, WARP, or other VPNs keep working.
What it does and doesn\'t do
It filters ad and tracker domains for the whole phone. It does not hide your IP address or block ads per app.
To change system DNS settings, AetherDNS needs WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. Grant it once via Shizuku (no PC) or ADB. You can also skip this and set DNS manually.
AdGuard DNS is a good default for blocking ads. You can change it any time or test speed and filtering from the main screen.
